subject: Token exposure notification and evidence onboarding request
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <security@finops.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Detection: short-lived token exposure — initial ask

Hi team,

We observed anomalous calls originating from a short-lived service token issued to a third-party connector between 2027-04-04T22:30Z and 2027-04-04T23:05Z. The activity appears to have been limited to non-sensitive read-only metadata endpoints, but our SOC team needs artifacts for our audit and remediation timeline.

Can you please provide the following by EOD your local time tomorrow (2027-04-06):
- A brief incident notification and timeline (first seen, containment actions taken).
- Export of request logs for the window 2027-04-04T22:00Z — 2027-04-04T23:30Z (sanitized if necessary).
- The incident response plan (IRP) section that covers short-lived token misuse or compromised third-party connectors (SOC 2 / SIG references appreciated).
- Any temporary mitigations (token revocation snapshot, rotation timestamps).

We understand this is sensitive — we can accept artifacts via a secure S3 share or a Google Drive folder with restricted access. For traceability, please reference our ticket: SUP-12345.

Point of contact here is Elena Cruz (security@finops.com). If you prefer a short call to walk through artifacts we can do a 20‑minute session later today.

Thanks,
Elena Cruz
Security Operations
FinOps Inc.
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Cruz <security@finops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Detection: short-lived token exposure — initial ask

Elena, thanks for the heads-up — we appreciate the detail and the ticket reference.

Acknowledged. Immediate plan from our side:
1) I will confirm token revocation time and paste the rotation event.
2) Marissa will prepare a sanitized log export for the requested window and drop a short sample to this thread for validation.
3) Karthik will pull the IRP excerpt and a SIG/SOC2 mapping that specifically addresses ephemeral credentials and third-party connectors.
4) Soojin will prepare a telemetry export for any anomalous latencies/errors correlated to the window.

We will aim to provide an initial artifact bundle by EOD 2027-04-06 PST. If any artifacts contain customer PII we will sanitize prior to sharing.

Attaching a 2-line sanitized log sample for quick verification of format (sanitized_log_sample_20270405.txt).

Would you like us to upload to your S3 or share a restricted Google Drive? We can do either; please confirm and we will send an access grant.

Mateo Alvarez
Incident Response Lead, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
From: Elena Cruz <security@finops.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Detection: short-lived token exposure — initial ask

Thanks Mateo — we can accept either. Secure S3 is preferred for the full exports (we will provide a time-limited pre-signed PUT/S3 bucket). For quick validation, please share the sanitized sample to the Drive link below so our engineers can confirm fields and parsing.

Secure S3 upload details (will be sent from secops@finops.com when ready). Please include the following in the upload path: SUP-12345/artifacts/{your-org}/.

I will also open a formal evidence request under our SOC 2 audit packet; Raj Patel from Prime-Cust (copied on the formal request) will need the IRP excerpt and SIG mapping.

Elena
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Cruz <security@finops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Postmortem & evidence delivery — SUP-12345

Elena / Raj / FinOps SecOps,

Per the artifact request and our internal post-incident process, please find what we are delivering in the secure S3 upload path (SUP-12345/artifacts/mateo_alvarez/):
- telemetry_export_20270405.jsonl (sanitized token IDs, request ids)
- sanitized_log_sample_20270405.txt (same sample as earlier for format verification)
- postmortem_draft_20270406.pdf (preliminary timeline, root cause, containment/remediation steps, next actions)

High-level summary (short):
- First seen: 2027-04-04T22:31:12Z — a third-party connector made repeated read-only requests using a short-lived token.
- Containment: token was revoked at 2027-04-04T23:07:03Z; rotation enforced for related service accounts.
- Impact: metadata-only read operations; no PII or secrets exfiltrated per our initial telemetry.
- Root cause: automated connector logic did not expire cached tokens as expected in a narrow race condition; patch planned and deployed 2027-04-05T06:00Z UTC.

Next steps we propose:
- Finalize postmortem and provide a redacted copy for your SOC 2 packet by 2027-04-08.
- Update our SIG control mappings to call out ephemeral credential rotation checks (Karthik to deliver by 2027-04-09).
- Schedule a 30-minute walk-through for your auditors (proposed 2027-04-09 16:00 UTC).

If you need any additional artifacts or a different redaction level, reply with specifics and we will adjust.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Incident Response Lead
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: postmortem_draft_20270406.pdf — contains a full timeline and remedial code references (redacted).
